articles.title: Apple’s Earnings Will Test Stock’s Status as the AI Safety Play

articles.title: SK Hynix Slips Ahead of Big Tech Results | Bloomberg Tech 7/29/2026
articles.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down why SK Hynix's Korean shares slumped even after reporting a six-fold jump in profit and raised capital spending to a record $31 billion. Plus, SoFi CEO Anthony Noto joins following the company's earnings topping Wall Street estimates, but showing high expenses; and big tech earnings are on the docket, with Microsoft and Meta coming next. (Source: Bloomberg)
